text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Welcome home, Mom...! Even with your busy 
work schedule, thank you so much for 
making time for me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Was the flight bumpy? You're not too tired 
from travelling, are you...?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm perfectly fine! Full of energy! 
Come on, Scarlet, let's go have lunch!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Mom, you're the leader of such a 
huge project...?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible... You're amazing, Mom! 
Leading everyone forward at the front... 
Just like in your races!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! You're quite right. Maybe that part 
of me hasn't changed since back then. 
...Speaking of things that haven't 
changed—

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You wore that outfit today too. It really 
does look wonderful on you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's my favorite! After all, you 
picked it out for me, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am your mother, after all. I know 
what you like—

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... This pasta is spicier than I 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case I'll eat it for you! I'm 
totally fine with spicy—

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's alright. You're not good with spicy 
food, right?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
See, remember? When you were little at 
that curry shop, you insisted on getting 
spicy, but then burst into tears crying 
that your tongue was burning.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Th-that brings back memories. I 
guess that did happen.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
What you really love are sweet things. Oh, 
I know! Let's go buy some strawberry 
shortcake after this.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You used to say all the time, "It's the 
sweetest thing in the whole world, so I 
love it!" Come on, we don't have much 
time, so let's hurry!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Thanks, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mom, thanks for today! It was great 
getting to talk after so long, and thank 
you for the cake too.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it, at least let me do this 
much for you. ...I'm sorry we only ever 
get to spend such brief moments together.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine! Just being able to see you 
like this makes me happy. I'll be looking 
forward to your next visit home!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...About that. Work is going to get really 
busy starting next month. I'm not sure 
when I'll be able to come back next.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
We probably won't be able to see each 
other for a while, so is there anything 
you need or anything you're having trouble 
with?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I'm all good! Don't worry about 
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all in training, so do 
your best at work too, Mom!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Scarlet. For always cheering 
me on. Well then, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How old was I back then...? When shortcake 
was my absolute favorite...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... this is fine, right. I don't want 
to be a bother to Mom when she's so busy. 
...I need to get back soon and do my 
homework.

I spotted Daiwa Scarlet in front of the 
school gates. She seems to have a rather 
gloomy expression—
choice_data_list: On your way back from shopping?

text_block_list.text:
I spotted Daiwa Scarlet in front of the 
school gates. She seems to have a rather 
gloomy expression—
choice_data_list: On your way back from shopping?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, this is just a cake I got as a 
present.
choice_data_list: Did something happen with the present?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all! Um, my mom bought this 
cake for me! I was just so happy that I 
spaced out for a second!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've gotta put the cake in the 
fridge! Excuse me, then!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: .........! N-No, nothing's wrong at all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I got to see my mom today after 
such a long time! We had lunch together 
and she even bought me a present!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I have to give it my all in training so I 
can share good news with her...!
